name: script/watch-run
title: Re-run on file change
summary: Run a command again whenever files change (inotifywait, with a polling fallback).
when: Use while developing: the command runs again on every save instead of by hand.

command.about: Command line to run on each change; split on spaces, so no shell quoting inside it.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, set the command at the top of the script, then run ./watch-run.sh on the folder to watch and save a file in it.
